description: Enteric virus concentrations, pH and turbidity in wastewater discharged to the Conwy River and estuary, North Wales (2016-2017) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. This dataset contains pH, turbidity and viral concentration information in untreated and treated wastewater samples at wastewater discharge points and wastewater treatment plants along the Conwy River. The aim of the data collection was to investigate diurnal changes in enteric virus concentrations in wastewater and to investigate any correlation with wastewater pH and turbidity. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Conwy Valley, Diurnal changes , Enteric virus monitoring, Environmental Microbiology and Human Health (EMHH), Human Health and Safety. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
